name: zein-hub-root
description: Zein Hub Platform - Monorepo root for Backend and Frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgYellow.bold" "npm --prefix \"Zein Hub Backend\" run dev" "npm --prefix \"Zein Hub Frontend\" run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix "Zein Hub Backend" run build && npm --prefix "Zein Hub Frontend" run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix "Zein Hub Backend" install && npm --prefix "Zein Hub Frontend" install
